p: house of the LORD God: That is, the place in which he will be worshipped.
strangers that were in the land: Meaning, cunning men of other nations who dwelt among the Jews.
in abundance for the nails for: That is, which weighed fifty shekels of gold, 2Ch 3:9.

Thou hast shed blood abundantly: This declares how greatly God detests the shedding of blood, seeing David for this cause is prevented from building the temple of the Lord, though he enterprised no war, but by God's command and against his enemies.
prosper thou: He shows that there can be no prosperity, but when the Lord is with us.
wisdom and understanding: These are only the means by which kings govern their subjects correctly, and by which the realms prosper and flourish.
trouble I have prepared for the: For David was poor in respect to Solomon.
Arise therefore: That is, go about it quickly.
inhabitants of the land into mine: The nations round about.
your heart and your soul to: For else he knew that God would plague them, and not prosper their labour, unless they sought with all their hearts to set forth his glory.
